Born: November 23, 1992, 4:19 PM local time, Nashville, Tennessee, USA. Source: Astro-Databank, Rodden rating AA.

The AA rating means the birth time comes from a birth certificate or an equally solid record, so the rising sign, the Midheaven and the houses below can be read at face value. Open Miley Cyrus's chart on Astrolas to follow along.

Three planets sit within four degrees of each other in late Scorpio, all in the same house. The Moon at 26°13', Mercury at 27°12' and Pluto at 23°14' are mutually conjunct, and all three land in the 6th house, the library's house of daily work and routine.

She was born Destiny Hope Cyrus, the daughter of country singer Billy Ray Cyrus, and became famous playing a girl who lives two lives, an ordinary schoolgirl by day and a pop star by night, on Disney Channel's Hannah Montana. A triple Scorpio conjunction tucked into the house of daily routine is a fitting match for a childhood spent living that exact split every day, on a work schedule.

muc.ten: Moon, Mercury and Pluto in Scorpio, in the 6th house
doan: In order of degree: Pluto at 23°14', the Moon at 26°13' and Mercury at 27°12', all Scorpio, all in the 6th.

The library's Moon in Scorpio keeps real feeling behind a calm, controlled surface, suspicious of motives until trust is fully earned. Mercury in Scorpio wants the truth under the surface of any subject and speaks only when it has something worth saying. Pluto in Scorpio, generational for her whole age group, gives an instinct for the hidden links between money, control and power, plus a private inner world that only a few people ever reach. In the 6th house, the library describes work that keeps shifting day to day even while the job itself stays the same, colleagues treated like family, and emotional health that runs in step with physical health. Mercury here, retrograde in her chart, adds a need for stable work that stimulates the mind and a habit of expressing a thought at its own pace, with careful thought, rather than right away.

The three planets talk directly to each other. Moon conjunct Mercury, orb 0°59', the library reads as intelligence and an excellent memory that lends real confidence to communication, though decisions tend to run on feeling more than logic. Moon conjunct Pluto, orb 2°59', brings a captivating, controlling presence with intense emotion, best used on anything with wide influence rather than kept bottled up over small things. Mercury conjunct Pluto, orb 3°58', sharpens all of it into a mind built for digging up secrets, with real writing talent attached.
Her own double life fits this reading closely. Hannah Montana ran for four seasons, a job that never let the daily routine settle, switching identities on camera and off.
Zodiac sign Scorpio Water · Fixed · Pluto The depth charge. The one who goes to the bottom.
Planet Mercury Rules Gemini, Virgo Communication, thinking, flexibility
Planet Pluto Rules Scorpio Transformation, rebirth, power
Zodiac sign Sagittarius Fire · Mutable · Jupiter The bard. The one who needs the bigger story.

muc.ten: Sun in Sagittarius, in the 7th house
doan: The Sun sits at 1°53' Sagittarius, in the 7th house, the house the library ties to marriage and one-on-one partnership.

The library's Sagittarius Sun is optimistic, outspoken and hungry for experience, more drawn to broad horizons than small, safe routines, with a weak spot for overpromising and losing patience with details. In the 7th house, it adds that identity and motivation become tied up in a partner, sometimes to the point of seeking a relationship just to have someone beside them rather than building independence first. The library also calls this a strong placement for success and standing gained through a lasting, influential partnership.

Her relationship history has played out largely in public. She met actor Liam Hemsworth filming The Last Song in 2009, the two were on and off for years, and they married in December 2018. They separated in 2019. Few public figures have had one partnership followed this closely for this long.

muc.ten: Venus conjunct Uranus in Capricorn, in the 8th house
doan: Venus at 12°27' and Uranus at 15°36' Capricorn are conjunct, orb 3°08', both in the 8th house. Neptune sits nearby too, at 17°03' Capricorn, one house over in the 9th.

The library calls Venus conjunct Uranus a "lightning strike" aspect: a captivating, independent personality, relationships that start fast and can end just as fast, and finances that swing unpredictably between sudden luck and sudden loss. Uranus and Neptune in Capricorn are generational, shared with her whole age group, Uranus for a drive to reshape rigid structures, Neptune for turning spiritual ideals into disciplined, practical action. Uranus and Neptune are themselves conjunct, orb 1°28', which the library reads as a powerful but unstable mix of imagination and anxiety, inspiring but prone to disillusionment unless the dreaming gets turned into something workable.

Reinvention has been the throughline of her career, from the wholesome Disney image to the deliberately provocative Can't Be Tamed and Bangerz eras to the steadier sound of her recent albums. Each turn landed suddenly rather than gradually, and in public, close to the library's "lightning strike" language.

muc.ten: Jupiter in Libra, in the 5th house
doan: Jupiter sits at 8°34' Libra, in the 5th house, the house of creativity, performance and children.

The library's Jupiter in Libra brings charm, magnetism and good fortune that often arrives through relationships and partnership, with a real aesthetic sense suited to music and the arts. In the 5th house, it adds abundant creative energy across many outlets at once, a fondness for the stage and vivid self-expression, and warm, cheerful romantic luck, with the caution to pick one lane rather than chase every interest at once.

Hannah Montana was built on exactly that kind of lucky partnership: a Disney Channel deal that handed a teenager a performance outlet most performers never get this early. The show's own premise, split between an everyday identity and a stage one, gave her 5th house years of practice at performing before she had even finished school.

muc.ten: Saturn in Aquarius, in the 10th house
doan: Saturn sits at 13°04' Aquarius, in the 10th house, the house of career and public standing.

The library's Aquarius Saturn mixes discipline with humanitarian, innovative thinking, good at building a public reputation but prone to stubbornness about its own ideas. In the 10th house, the library is specific: success comes late, usually after the age of thirty, built slowly through a "slow but sure" strategy, and arriving with real prestige once it lands.

She turned thirty in November 2022. "Flowers" came out two months later and went on to win her first Grammy Awards, including Record of the Year, in February 2024. Two decades of work before that first Grammy is a long runway, and it tracks closely with the library's timeline for this placement. Off stage, she founded the Happy Hippie Foundation in 2014, a charity for homeless and LGBTQ+ youth, the kind of humanitarian cause the library ties to Saturn in Aquarius.

muc.ten: Mars in Cancer, in the 3rd house
doan: Mars sits at 27°27' Cancer, in the 3rd house, the house of siblings, everyday communication and short trips.

The library's Mars in Cancer softens the planet's usual directness into something driven by feeling, advancing like a tide rather than a single sharp strike, with a strong pull to cling to a relationship, a project or an idea past the point it still serves. In the 3rd house, the library adds a quick, competitive mind that would rather argue a point out internally than aloud, plus the kind of tension with siblings that comes from miscommunication rather than real conflict.

She grew up in a large musical family, with her father Billy Ray Cyrus and her sister Noah Cyrus both working in music, and has recorded and performed alongside family members more than once over the years.

muc.ten: What the chart adds up to
doan: The chart doesn't explain a hit song, and it can't account for stage presence. What it shows is where the weight sits: a triple conjunction of Moon, Mercury and Pluto in late Scorpio, buried in the 6th house of daily routine, a fitting engine for someone whose job once meant living two identities at once, on a schedule. The Sun in the 7th keeps her identity bound up with partnership, Venus and Uranus in Capricorn supply the sudden, public reinventions, and Saturn in Aquarius explains why the institutional recognition, the Grammys, arrived only after thirty.
Open Miley Cyrus's chart on Astrolas, find the Scorpio cluster in the 6th house, then compare it with a chart you know.
Taurus, at 28°39', based on her AA-rated birth time of 4:19 PM. The Astrolas library doesn't yet have an entry for Taurus rising, so this piece treats it as a chart fact rather than a reading.
Her Sun is Sagittarius, at 1°53' in the 7th house. Her Moon is Scorpio, at 26°13' in the 6th house, within three degrees of both Mercury and Pluto.

A triple conjunction of the Moon, Mercury and Pluto, all in late Scorpio and all in the 6th house. All three planets aspect each other directly, which concentrates an unusual amount of the chart's weight into one tight cluster.
